verdict.rationale: Mercury documents all three pillars in one account. For banking it offers checking, savings and treasury accounts plus ACH, wire and check payouts (mercury-docs-39, mercury-docs-53, mercury-docs-57). For spend it offers corporate and virtual cards with limits, reimbursements and approvals "all in one place" (mercury-docs-2, mercury-docs-10, mercury-docs-38). For bill pay it offers AI-populated bills (mercury-docs-3). Invoicing, receipt matching and accounting sync round out the consolidation story (mercury-docs-4, mercury-docs-5, mercury-docs-6), and a 5-year customer confirms using it heavily for cards, accounts and wires (mercury-comm-1). Missing for 10: bill pay is evidenced only by a single marketing line with no depth on bill approval workflows or scheduling, and there is no independent account of a founder actually replacing separate spend or bill-pay tools with Mercury.
